title: Sentinel-1 Analysis Ready Data - Backscatter (CARD-BS)
description: Analysis Ready Data derived from Sentinel-1 GRD products: radiometrically calibrated, thermal-noise-removed, border-noise-removed, geocoded and terrain-corrected gamma nought (Gamma0) backscatter, produced with the ESA SNAP Graph Processing Tool using a Copernicus DEM. Ground range coordinates represent the slant range coordinates projected onto the ellipsoid of the Earth. The pixel values correspond to the detected magnitude, while phase information is not retained. Multi-look processing gives the product an approximately square spatial resolution and pixel spacing, which helps reduce speckle. A noise vector annotation dataset is included with each product so that thermal noise correction can be applied by subtracting the noise values from the detected power, for example using the Sentinel-1 Toolbox (S1TBX).
